zh.description: 来源群或私聊共享文件夹里的文件，话题使用同一份:列表、markdown 源码编辑与预览、JSON 的查看与修改。几个人和 agent 同时改同一个文件,各自的改动都在。

en.description: The files in the source group or private chat's shared folder, also used by its topics: the list, markdown source editing and preview, viewing and changing JSON. When several people and agents change the same file at once, everyone's changes stay.
